messages:
marta_finance: Heads up — SquirrelPay (acct 001234) invoice 4921 failed at gateway, card declined. Stripe reason shows `do_not_honor`. Dropping here to coordinate retry/fallback.

sam_ops: Can we auto-retry? what's our policy for repeated declines? @ryan_payments

ryan_payments: We do 3 auto retries for transient fails, but `do_not_honor` usually requires customer action. Recommend pause retries and offer wire/ACH. @jess_cs can you confirm customer preference?

jess_cs: Customer already replied — they prefer wire, asked for wiring instructions. Also asked to not attempt the card again.

marta_finance: OK paused auto-retries. @stripe-bot please cancel scheduled retry attempts for this charge.

stripe-bot: Action taken — scheduled retries canceled for charge `ch_3KabcDEF` (requested by marta_finance). :white_check_mark:

sam_ops: Wire details we typically send (ops-only copy):

Beneficiary: SquirrelPay Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT: ABCDUS33
Reference: Invoice 4921

(please keep routing + account in ops ticket)

jess_cs: I'll send that to Ana at SquirrelPay. Quick Q: do we cover incoming bank fees? they asked if we can waive fees for this payment.

ryan_payments: Standard is pass-through, but we can offer to cover up to $50 as a one-time courtesy. Confirm with finance.

marta_finance: Approved — offer to cover wire fee up to $50. I'll mark invoice as "manual payment pending" in the billing portal and add note.

nora_engine: Adding telemetry tag to prevent billing retry webhooks: `no_retry_manual` on acct 001234. Will create a short-lived exemption for 7 days.

sam_ops: Tag applied and OPS ticket created: OPS-4421. Will watch for incoming funds and reconcile.

jess_cs: Email sent to SquirrelPay (copy of message):

"Hi Ana — we've paused further card attempts. Please find our wire instructions below. We'll cover up to $50 of bank fees for this payment. Once you send the wire, reply with the receipt and we'll apply the payment immediately and confirm.

Beneficiary: SquirrelPay Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 021000021
SWIFT: ABCDUS33
Reference: Invoice 4921"

marta_finance: Perfect — thanks team. I'll close the thread once payment posts. If they request a contract change for payment terms, CC legal.

ryan_payments: Noted. I'll also add a quick note in billing playbook about `do_not_honor` cases so CS has a template next time.

jess_cs: will follow up if they ask for ACH microdeposit steps instead.

marta_finance: Closing for now, tracking under OPS-4421. :lock_with_key:
